summary.text: Scott Franklin is the incumbent Republican U.S. Representative for the 18th District, first elected in 2020. A Naval Academy graduate and former naval aviator, he ran an insurance agency in Lakeland and served on the Lakeland City Commission before Congress. He sits on the House Appropriations Committee and chairs a Science, Space, and Technology subcommittee.

paragraphs.text: Franklin was born in Thomaston, Georgia, and graduated from Lakeland High School.

He earned a bachelor's degree from the U.S. Naval Academy in 1986 and an MBA from Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University in 1994; his official biography also lists the Air Command & Staff College and Wharton's Executive Leadership Development Program.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 1986 to 2000 and in the Navy Reserve from 2000 to 2012, including as a naval aviator.

Franklin joined the Lanier Upshaw insurance agency in Lakeland in 2000 and led it as president and CEO for 20 years until it merged into BKS Partners on January 1, 2020, where he was managing partner, according to his official biography.

His civic roles included chairman of the Florida chapter of the Young Presidents Organization and service with the Lakeland Economic Development Council, Lakeland Rotary Club and Lakeland Chamber of Commerce.
He served on the Lakeland City Commission for the Southeast district and as Mayor Pro Tem; Wikipedia gives his term as January 2018 to January 2021, after his 2017 election.
Franklin won the 2020 Republican primary against then-Rep. Ross Spano and the general election in the then-15th District, and was sworn into Congress on January 3, 2021.
He now represents the 18th District, and was sworn in for a third term on January 3, 2025.

He serves on the House Appropriations Committee, on its Agriculture, Military Construction and Veterans Affairs, and Energy and Water subcommittees, and chairs the Science, Space, and Technology Committee's Environment Subcommittee.
In 2023 Speaker McCarthy appointed him to the Naval Academy Board of Visitors.
His official biography says he and his wife, Amy, have been married for over 30 years and have three adult children.
